S01: Long ago, the rivers and seas were empty — without a single fish.
S02: The water was clear, but utterly still — nothing swam in it.
S03: On the shore, a child played all alone.
S04: It played with pebbles and sand at the very edge of the water.
S05: Suddenly, the child raised its head.
S06: Before it stood an enormous tree — and that tree was walking.
S07: Its roots lifted from the ground as if they were legs.
S08: The trunk was so huge it shadowed the whole length of the shore.
S09: The child froze with wonder and fear.
S10: Then it turned and dashed toward the village.
S11: It ran down the path, shouting at the top of its lungs.
S12: Child: "Quick, come! A terrible danger is approaching!"
S13: The men and women came out of their huts.
S15: The whole village set out toward the tree, weapons in hand.
S16: And the tree, meanwhile, simply kept walking.
S17: They threw themselves upon the enormous trunk.
S18: With knives and axes they began striking the trunk.
S20: Yet the tree, carefree, continued its stride.
S21: If it comes here, it will destroy everything! they thought in fear.
S22: And so they attacked the enormous trunk even more fiercely.
S23: The knives bit deep, wood splinters flying everywhere.
S24: The trunk began to show deep wounds.
S25: For the first time, the tree swayed.
S26: The villagers' faces were flushed with exertion.
S27: They tried to cut it at the very root of the trunk.
S28: All together, they heaved with their last strength.
S29: With a terrible sound, the trunk began to crack.
S30: The child watched from afar, hands over its mouth.
S32: It fell to the ground with a mighty crash.
S33: The earth shook beneath the impact.
S35: A strange silence fell as the dust settled.
S37: The crown shuddered and its fruits loosened.
S38: Hundreds of delicious fruits fell from the crown.
S39: The fruits glistened and rolled across the ground.
S40: Some rolled toward the sea, others toward the river.
S41: Some fruits ended up in the sea.
S42: They turned into the first sea fish.
S43: Silver, the first fish swam out into the blue of the sea.
S44: Soon, whole shoals swam through the sea.
S45: And other fruits ended up in the rivers.
S46: They too turned into the first freshwater fish.
S47: The first freshwater fish darted through the river.
S48: And the rivers filled with life.
S49: In no time, fish populated all the waters of the world.
S50: The child stood on the shore, smiling, watching the new world fill with life.
